1.4.1.1-r1.burton_quote: If that evacuation of haemorrhoids, or varices which they call the water between the skin, shall happen to a melancholy man, his misery is ended

1.4.1.1-r12.burton_quote: let us give God thanks, that no man is compelled to live against his will

1.4.1.1-r15.burton_quote: And a harder choice to live in fear, than by once dying, to be freed from all

1.4.1.1-r18.burton_quote: as a ship that is void of a Pilot, must needs impinge upon the next rock or sands, and suffer shipwreck

1.4.1.1-r2.burton_quote: When melancholy gets out at the superficies of the skin, or settles breaking out in scabs, leprosy, morphew, or is purged by stools, or by the urine, or that the spleen is enlarged, and those varices appear, the disease is dissolved

1.4.1.1-r3.burton_quote: be it in whom it will, or from what cause soever, it is ever long, wayward, tedious, and hard to be cured

1.4.1.1-r4.burton_quote: the queen of diseases, and inexorable

1.4.1.1-r5.burton_quote: imagination be hurt, and not reason

1.4.1.1-r6.burton_quote: the gentlest is from blood. Worse from choler adust, but the worst of all from melancholy putrefied

1.4.1.1-r8.burton_quote: This malady doth commonly accompany them to their grave; physicians may ease, and it may lie hid for a time, but they cannot quite cure it, but it will return again more violent & sharp than at first, and that upon every small occasion or error

1.4.1.1-r9.burton_quote: Oftentimes it degenerates into Epilepsy, Apoplexy, Convulsions, and blindness
